en.learnIntro: Every lesson from the Baan Rod Mai? flood-safety game: what to do before a flood and what to check before moving back in, each with its Thai agency source.
en.llmsSummary: Baan Rod Mai? ("Will the house survive?") is a free, 60-second Thai flood-safety game for phones, with an English toggle. In "Before the flood" (ก่อนน้ำมา) players prepare an illustrated house; in "After the water recedes" (หลังน้ำลด) they spot the dangers before moving back in. Every correct action comes from Thai government agency guidance and is linked to its source. No sign-up, no cookies, no personal data.
